def locale_of(path):
    seg = path.strip("/").split("/")[0] if path.strip("/") else ""
    return seg if seg in LOCALES else "en"


def section_of(path, loc):
    p = path.strip("/")
    if loc != "en" and p.startswith(loc):
        p = p[len(loc):].strip("/")
    if not p:
        return "home"
    first = p.split("/")[0]
    if first in ("blog", "artigos", "diario", "blogue", "beulrogeu",
                 "blogeintrage"):
        return "blog" if "/" in p else "blog-index"
    return first


def h8(s):
    return hashlib.blake2b(s.encode("utf-8"), digest_size=8).digest()


def one(args):
    fname, url = args
    try:
        raw = open(os.path.join(RAW, fname), "rb").read()
    except Exception:
        return None
    d = extract.parse(raw)
    path = urlsplit(url).path
    loc = locale_of(path)

    vis = [b for b, hid in d.blocks if not hid]
    hid = [b for b, hid in d.blocks if hid]
    body = "\n".join(vis)

    bw, bchars, bcjk, blatin = extract.count_text(body)
    hw = extract.count_text("\n".join(hid))[0] if hid else 0
    cw = extract.count_text("\n".join(d.code_blocks))[0] if d.code_blocks else 0

    meta_txt = " ".join([d.title.strip()] + [v for v in d.meta.values()])
    mw = extract.count_text(meta_txt)[0] if meta_txt.strip() else 0
    attr_txt = " ".join(t for _, t in d.attr_items)
    aw = extract.count_text(attr_txt)[0] if attr_txt.strip() else 0

    # CAT-style segments over the visible body
    segs = []
    for b in vis:
        for s in extract.segments(b):
            n = extract.norm_seg(s)
            if not n:
                continue
            w = extract.count_text(s)[0]
            if w:
                segs.append((h8(n), w, s))
    return {
        "url": url, "file": fname, "path": path, "locale": loc,
        "section": section_of(path, loc), "lang_attr": d.lang,
        "title": d.title.strip()[:200],
        "blocks": len(vis), "hidden_blocks": len(hid),
        "body_words": bw, "latin_words": blatin, "cjk_chars": bcjk,
        "chars_nospace": bchars,
        "hidden_words": hw, "code_words": cw,
        "meta_words": mw, "attr_words": aw,
        "segs": [(a, b) for a, b, _ in segs],
        "seg_samples": [(a, c[:300]) for a, b, c in segs],
        "content_hash": hashlib.blake2b(
            extract.norm_seg(body).encode(), digest_size=12).hexdigest(),
    }


def main():
    res = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "crawl_results.json")))
    tasks = [(v["path"], u) for u, v in sorted(res.items())
             if v.get("html") and v.get("status") == 200 and v.get("path")]
    print(f"pages to analyze: {len(tasks)}", flush=True)

    recs = []
    with Pool(os.cpu_count() or 4) as p:
        for i, r in enumerate(p.imap_unordered(one, tasks, chunksize=16), 1):
            if r:
                recs.append(r)
            if i % 1000 == 0:
                print(f"  {i}/{len(tasks)}", flush=True)

    recs.sort(key=lambda r: r["url"])
    print(f"analyzed {len(recs)} pages", flush=True)

    # ---- global segment sample map + page frequency
    sample = {}
    seg_pages = collections.Counter()   # hash -> # pages containing it
    for r in recs:
        for hh, tx in r["seg_samples"]:
            if hh not in sample:
                sample[hh] = tx
        for hh in {h for h, _ in r["segs"]}:
            seg_pages[hh] += 1
        del r["seg_samples"]

    # ---- per-locale repetition (CAT-style: 1st occurrence new, rest repeats)
    per_loc = {}
    for loc in ["en"] + LOCALES:
        pages = [r for r in recs if r["locale"] == loc]
        seen = set()
        tot = new = rep = 0
        for r in pages:
            for hh, w in r["segs"]:
                tot += w
                if hh in seen:
                    rep += w
                else:
                    seen.add(hh)
                    new += w
        per_loc[loc] = {
            "pages": len(pages),
            "body_words": sum(r["body_words"] for r in pages),
            "meta_words": sum(r["meta_words"] for r in pages),
            "attr_words": sum(r["attr_words"] for r in pages),
            "code_words": sum(r["code_words"] for r in pages),
            "cjk_chars": sum(r["cjk_chars"] for r in pages),
            "chars_nospace": sum(r["chars_nospace"] for r in pages),
            "seg_total_words": tot, "seg_new_words": new,
            "seg_repeated_words": rep,
            "distinct_segments": len(seen),
            "dup_pages": len(pages) - len({r["content_hash"] for r in pages}),
        }

    # ---- boilerplate: segments present on >=50% of English pages
    en_pages = [r for r in recs if r["locale"] == "en"]
    n_en = max(1, len(en_pages))
    boiler = [(hh, c) for hh, c in seg_pages.items() if c >= 0.5 * n_en]
    boiler_h = {hh for hh, _ in boiler}
    boiler_words_per_page = collections.Counter()
    for r in en_pages:
        w = sum(w for hh, w in r["segs"] if hh in boiler_h)
        boiler_words_per_page[r["url"]] = w

    top_boiler = sorted(boiler, key=lambda x: -x[1])[:40]

    # ---- write outputs
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "pages.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
        cols = ["url", "locale", "section", "lang_attr", "title", "blocks",
                "body_words", "meta_words", "attr_words", "code_words",
                "cjk_chars", "chars_nospace", "hidden_words", "content_hash"]
        wr = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=cols, extrasaction="ignore")
        wr.writeheader()
        for r in recs:
            wr.writerow(r)

    summary = {
        "pages_total": len(recs),
        "per_locale": per_loc,
        "boilerplate_segments": len(boiler_h),
        "boiler_words_median_en": (
            sorted(boiler_words_per_page.values())[len(en_pages)//2]
            if en_pages else 0),
        "top_boilerplate": [
            {"pages": c, "text": sample.get(hh, "")[:160]}
            for hh, c in top_boiler],
    }
    json.dump(summary, open(os.path.join(OUT, "summary.json"), "w"),
              indent=1, ensure_ascii=False)

    # section breakdown for English
    sec = collections.Counter()
    secw = collections.Counter()
    for r in en_pages:
        sec[r["section"]] += 1
        secw[r["section"]] += r["body_words"]
    json.dump({"counts": dict(sec), "words": dict(secw)},
              open(os.path.join(OUT, "en_sections.json"), "w"), indent=1)

    print(json.dumps({k: {kk: vv for kk, vv in v.items()}
                      for k, v in per_loc.items()}, indent=1))
    print("pages_total", len(recs))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""English-source detail: sections, boilerplate cost, net-new words."""
import os, sys, json, csv, collections, hashlib

import extract
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
RAW = os.path.join(HERE, "raw")
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "out")

LOCALES = {"pt", "es", "fr", "de", "ko", "it", "ar", "zh", "ja", "sv"}

    if not (v.get("html") and v.get("status") == 200 and v.get("path")):
        continue
    p = urlsplit(u).path.strip("/")
    if p.split("/")[0] in LOCALES:
        continue
    en.append((u, v["path"]))
print(f"English pages: {len(en)}")

sample = {}
for u, f in en:
    d = extract.parse(open(os.path.join(RAW, f), "rb").read())
    vis = [b for b, hid in d.blocks if not hid]
    segs = []
    for b in vis:
        for s in extract.segments(b):
            n = extract.norm_seg(s)
            if not n:
                continue
            w = extract.count_text(s)[0]
            if w:
                hh = h8(n)
                segs.append((hh, w))
                sample.setdefault(hh, s[:200])
    for hh in {h for h, _ in segs}:
        seg_pages[hh] += 1
    meta_txt = " ".join([d.title.strip()] + list(d.meta.values()))
    pages.append({
        "url": u,
        "path": urlsplit(u).path,
        "title": d.title.strip()[:120],
        "body_words": extract.count_text("\n".join(vis))[0] if vis else 0,
        "meta_words": extract.count_text(meta_txt)[0] if meta_txt.strip() else 0,
        "attr_words": extract.count_text(
            " ".join(t for _, t in d.attr_items))[0] if d.attr_items else 0,
        "segs": segs,
    })

N = len(pages)
BOIL_T = 0.5 * N
boiler = {hh for hh, c in seg_pages.items() if c >= BOIL_T}

# per-page boilerplate vs unique
for p in pages:
    p["boiler_words"] = sum(w for hh, w in p["segs"] if hh in boiler)
    p["unique_words"] = p["body_words"] - p["boiler_words"]


def section(path):
    p = path.strip("/")
    if not p:
        return "home"
    parts = p.split("/")
    if parts[0] == "blog":
        return "blog-post" if len(parts) > 1 else "blog-index"
    if parts[0] in ("industries", "services", "authors"):
        return parts[0]
    return "marketing/other"


sec_pages = collections.Counter()
sec_body = collections.Counter()
sec_uniq = collections.Counter()
for p in pages:
    s = section(p["path"])
    sec_pages[s] += 1
    sec_body[s] += p["body_words"]
    sec_uniq[s] += p["unique_words"]

# CAT-style running dedup (page order = url sort)
seen = set()
new = rep = 0
for p in pages:
    for hh, w in p["segs"]:
        if hh in seen:
            rep += w
        else:
            seen.add(hh)
            new += w

body = sum(p["body_words"] for p in pages)
meta = sum(p["meta_words"] for p in pages)
attr = sum(p["attr_words"] for p in pages)
boil_total = sum(p["boiler_words"] for p in pages)
uniq_total = sum(p["unique_words"] for p in pages)

print(f"""
=== ENGLISH SOURCE TOTALS ===
pages                      {N:>12,}
body words (gross)         {body:>12,}
  of which boilerplate     {boil_total:>12,}  ({100*boil_total/body:.1f}%)
  page-unique content      {uniq_total:>12,}  ({100*uniq_total/body:.1f}%)
meta (title+description)   {meta:>12,}
image alt / aria / labels  {attr:>12,}
GROSS TOTAL (all strings)  {body+meta+attr:>12,}

CAT-style dedup over body text:
  new (unique) words       {new:>12,}
  repetitions              {rep:>12,}  ({100*rep/body:.1f}%)
  distinct segments        {len(seen):>12,}
  boilerplate segments     {len(boiler):>12,}
  median boiler words/page {sorted(p['boiler_words'] for p in pages)[N//2]:>12,}
""")

print("=== BY SECTION (English) ===")
print(f"{'section':20}{'pages':>7}{'gross words':>14}{'unique words':>14}{'avg uniq/pg':>13}")
for s, c in sec_pages.most_common():
    print(f"{s:20}{c:>7}{sec_body[s]:>14,}{sec_uniq[s]:>14,}"
          f"{sec_uniq[s]//max(1,c):>13,}")

print("\n=== TOP 15 ENGLISH PAGES BY UNIQUE CONTENT ===")
for p in sorted(pages, key=lambda x: -x["unique_words"])[:15]:
    print(f"  {p['unique_words']:>6,} uniq / {p['body_words']:>6,} gross  {p['path'][:70]}")

print("\n=== 15 THINNEST ENGLISH PAGES (unique content) ===")
for p in sorted(pages, key=lambda x: x["unique_words"])[:15]:
    print(f"  {p['unique_words']:>6,} uniq / {p['body_words']:>6,} gross  {p['path'][:70]}")

with open(os.path.join(OUT, "english_pages.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
    wr = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=["url", "path", "title", "body_words",
                                       "boiler_words", "unique_words",
                                       "meta_words", "attr_words"],
                        extrasaction="ignore")
    wr.writeheader()
    for p in sorted(pages, key=lambda x: -x["unique_words"]):
        wr.writerow(p)

json.dump({"pages": N, "body": body, "meta": meta, "attr": attr,
           "boiler": boil_total, "unique": uniq_total,
           "cat_new": new, "cat_rep": rep,
           "distinct_segments": len(seen),
           "sections": {s: {"pages": sec_pages[s], "gross": sec_body[s],
                            "unique": sec_uniq[s]} for s in sec_pages}},
          open(os.path.join(OUT, "english_summary.json"), "w"), indent=1)

import extract
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

RAW = os.path.join(HERE, "raw")
LOCALES = {"pt", "es", "fr", "de", "ko", "it", "ar", "zh", "ja", "sv"}

STRIP = re.compile(
    r"<(script|style|noscript|template|svg)\b[^>]*>.*?</\1\s*>", re.S | re.I)


def crude_words(raw):
    s = raw.decode("utf-8", "replace")
    s = re.sub(r"<!--.*?-->", " ", s, flags=re.S)
    s = re.sub(r"<head\b[^>]*>.*?</head\s*>", " ", s, flags=re.S | re.I)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Final pass: per-script-correct word counts + repetition, all locales."""
import os, re, sys, json, csv, hashlib, collections, unicodedata
from multiprocessing import Pool
from urllib.parse import urlsplit

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import extract

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
RAW = os.path.join(HERE, "raw")
OUT = os.path.join(HERE, "out")
os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)

LOCALES = ["pt", "es", "fr", "de", "ko", "it", "ar", "zh", "ja", "sv"]
# zh/ja have no inter-word spaces -> character count is the billing unit.
# ko DOES use spaces -> whitespace words (eojeol) is the billing unit.
CHARBASED = {"zh", "ja"}
WORDCHAR = re.compile(r"[^\W_]", re.U)


def ws_words(t):
    """Whitespace-token word count (standard CAT word count)."""
    return sum(1 for w in t.split() if WORDCHAR.search(w))


def h8(s):
    return hashlib.blake2b(s.encode("utf-8"), digest_size=8).digest()


def locale_of(path):
    seg = path.strip("/").split("/")[0] if path.strip("/") else ""
    return seg if seg in LOCALES else "en"


def section_of(path, loc):
    p = path.strip("/")
    if loc != "en" and p.startswith(loc):
        p = p[len(loc):].strip("/")
    if not p:
        return "home"
    parts = p.split("/")
    if parts[0] in ("blog", "artigos", "diario", "blogue", "beulrogeu",
                    "blogeintrage"):
        return "blog-post" if len(parts) > 1 else "blog-index"
    if parts[0] in ("authors", "industries", "services", "platform",
                    "solutions", "episode", "terms"):
        return parts[0]
    return "marketing/other"


def one(args):
    fname, url = args
    try:
        raw = open(os.path.join(RAW, fname), "rb").read()
    except Exception:
        return None
    d = extract.parse(raw)
    path = urlsplit(url).path
    loc = locale_of(path)

    vis = [b for b, hid in d.blocks if not hid]
    hidb = [b for b, hid in d.blocks if hid]
    body = "\n".join(vis)
    meta_txt = " ".join([d.title.strip()] + list(d.meta.values()))
    attr_txt = " ".join(t for _, t in d.attr_items)

    cjk = len(extract.CJK.findall(body))
    segs = []
    for b in vis:
        for s in extract.segments(b):
            n = extract.norm_seg(s)
            if not n:
                continue
            w = len(extract.CJK.findall(s)) if loc in CHARBASED else ws_words(s)
            if w:
                segs.append((h8(n), w))
    return {
        "url": url, "path": path, "locale": loc,
        "section": section_of(path, loc),
        "title": d.title.strip()[:140],
        "words": ws_words(body),
        "cjk_chars": cjk,
        "chars_nospace": len(re.sub(r"\s", "", body)),
        "meta_words": ws_words(meta_txt),
        "meta_cjk": len(extract.CJK.findall(meta_txt)),
        "attr_words": ws_words(attr_txt),
        "hidden_words": ws_words("\n".join(hidb)),
        "blocks": len(vis),
        "segs": segs,
        "chash": hashlib.blake2b(extract.norm_seg(body).encode(),
                                 digest_size=12).hexdigest(),
    }


def main():
    res = json.load(open(os.path.join(HERE, "crawl_results.json")))
    tasks = [(v["path"], u) for u, v in sorted(res.items())
             if v.get("html") and v.get("status") == 200 and v.get("path")]
    recs = []
    with Pool(os.cpu_count() or 4) as p:
        for r in p.imap_unordered(one, tasks, chunksize=16):
            if r:
                recs.append(r)
    recs.sort(key=lambda r: r["url"])
    print(f"pages analyzed: {len(recs)}")

    out = {}
    for loc in ["en"] + LOCALES:
        pg = [r for r in recs if r["locale"] == loc]
        cb = loc in CHARBASED
        unit = "chars" if cb else "words"
        # billing-unit totals
        total = sum((r["cjk_chars"] if cb else r["words"]) for r in pg)
        seen, new, rep = set(), 0, 0
        for r in pg:
            for hh, w in r["segs"]:
                if hh in seen:
                    rep += w
                else:
                    seen.add(hh)
                    new += w
        # boilerplate: segments on >=50% of this locale's pages
        freq = collections.Counter()
        for r in pg:
            for hh in {h for h, _ in r["segs"]}:
                freq[hh] += 1
        boil = {hh for hh, c in freq.items() if c >= 0.5 * max(1, len(pg))}
        bw = sum(w for r in pg for hh, w in r["segs"] if hh in boil)
        out[loc] = {
            "unit": unit, "pages": len(pg),
            "total": total,
            "words_ws": sum(r["words"] for r in pg),
            "cjk_chars": sum(r["cjk_chars"] for r in pg),
            "chars_nospace": sum(r["chars_nospace"] for r in pg),
            "meta_words": sum(r["meta_words"] for r in pg),
            "meta_cjk": sum(r["meta_cjk"] for r in pg),
            "attr_words": sum(r["attr_words"] for r in pg),
            "hidden_words": sum(r["hidden_words"] for r in pg),
            "new": new, "rep": rep,
            "rep_pct": round(100 * rep / max(1, new + rep), 1),
            "boiler": bw,
            "boiler_pct": round(100 * bw / max(1, total), 1),
            "boiler_segments": len(boil),
            "distinct_segments": len(seen),
            "identical_pages": len(pg) - len({r["chash"] for r in pg}),
            "empty_pages": sum(1 for r in pg if r["words"] == 0),
        }

    # English sections
    en = [r for r in recs if r["locale"] == "en"]
    enfreq = collections.Counter()
    for r in en:
        for hh in {h for h, _ in r["segs"]}:
            enfreq[hh] += 1
    enboil = {hh for hh, c in enfreq.items() if c >= 0.5 * len(en)}
    sec = {}
    for r in en:
        b = sum(w for hh, w in r["segs"] if hh in enboil)
        r["boiler_words"] = b
        r["unique_words"] = r["words"] - b
        s = sec.setdefault(r["section"], {"pages": 0, "gross": 0, "uniq": 0})
        s["pages"] += 1
        s["gross"] += r["words"]
        s["uniq"] += r["unique_words"]

    json.dump({"per_locale": out, "en_sections": sec,
               "pages_total": len(recs)},
              open(os.path.join(OUT, "final.json"), "w"), indent=1)

    # full per-page CSV, all locales
    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "all_pages.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
        cols = ["url", "locale", "section", "title", "words", "cjk_chars",
                "chars_nospace", "meta_words", "attr_words", "hidden_words",
                "blocks"]
        wr = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=cols, extrasaction="ignore")
        wr.writeheader()
        for r in recs:
            wr.writerow(r)

    with open(os.path.join(OUT, "english_pages.csv"), "w", newline="") as f:
        cols = ["url", "section", "title", "words", "boiler_words",
                "unique_words", "meta_words", "attr_words"]
        wr = csv.DictWriter(f, fieldnames=cols, extrasaction="ignore")
        wr.writeheader()
        for r in sorted(en, key=lambda x: -x["unique_words"]):
            wr.writerow(r)

    print(json.dumps(out, indent=1))
    print("\nEN sections:", json.dumps(sec, indent=1))


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
